limits: Two clean pairs in opposite run orders; each uses the same original JAR and fixture, copied world/cache, 120-second warmup and 120-second recording.
Vanilla forward input with exactly matching end positions within both pairs, and normal sampled 20 TPS.
Asynchronous terrain completion, weather and hardware clocks can still vary.
Candidate worst frames are 52.20/59.15 ms versus control 47.46/64.62 ms; isolated stalls persist.
The earlier flyover attempt overlapped memory-heavy JSON analysis and was discarded; it is not included here.
